title: Cha-Cha Kolam Awam
subject: a thirty-five-year-old man taking swimming lessons at a public pool on Saturday mornings in the same class as six-year-olds, who cheer the day he finally floats
caption: 1960s Malay cha-cha revival, vintage Malay film-era dance band. Timbales and cowbell on the cha-cha pattern, bongos, a honking saxophone section, plucked double bass, bright upright piano montuno. Mono-leaning 1960s studio sound with slight room echo. Male tenor, crisp vintage crooner delivery with a backing chorus answering. 124 BPM, B-flat major. Cheeky, sunny and danceable. No autotune, no trap drums, no EDM drop, no modern synth bass, no reggaeton beat.
lyrics:
[Intro - saxophone riff, timbales and cowbell]

[Verse 1]
Sabtu pagi kolam awam
Saya umur tiga puluh lima
Kelas renang budak enam tahun
Saya paling tinggi, paling takut

[Pre-Chorus]
Cikgu tiup wisel
Semua lompat, saya tak

[Chorus]
Cha-cha kolam awam
Pegang papan, kaki tendang
Budak kecil gelak besar
Pakcik minum air klorin

[Verse 2]
Minggu ketiga, kepala basah
Minggu kelima, mata buka
Si Aiman pinjam pelampung
Dia kata, pakcik boleh

[Chorus]
Cha-cha kolam awam
Saya terapung, tangan lepas
Budak kecil tepuk tangan
Pakcik tak minum klorin lagi

[Outro - saxophone and piano montuno, chorus cheers]
